brief_rationale: The doctor met all responsibility chain items through proactive record querying, targeted symptom assessment, clear urgent thresholds, safe medication reconciliation, concrete follow-up planning, and teach-back confirmation. One high-order point (HO1) was completed by adapting the follow-up plan around transport/cost barriers with tiered options. HO3 was partially completed through active workspace querying and synthesis, though explicit record-grounded checklist integration was limited. HO2 and HO4 were not triggered as distinct beyond-minimum behaviors. No in-chain errors exist. Grade 4 applies.
